tactical.bull_case: RSI 31.5 and -23% from high with both canaries intact (GM 75% actual, guide 74% still ≥73) and NVDA OUTPERFORMING the factor on the worst day (+2.24pp) — nine of twelve ≥20% NVDA dips since 2010 were higher a year on. A clean print Nov 17 with a Q4 guide above $108B snaps the rotation hard given 2.1 beta.
tactical.falsifier: A confirmed NVDA-specific negative catalyst in the next 5 sessions (a Blackwell/Rubin supply cut, a lost hyperscaler socket, or the Megaspeed probe escalating from questions to charges) — reclassifying the air pocket from sector funding_anxiety to nvda_specific would flip this from a mild buy to neutral/trim.

positional.bear_case: The gross-margin guide-down is the FIRST of the cycle and analysts model 71-72% if memory scarcity persists — one more step and the canary degrades. DSO rose to 60 with inventory at $32B; a second quarter of receivables outgrowing revenue is a vendor-financed-demand canary. Below-both-MAs with a -19.3pp factor rotation is the market front-running digestion, and positional buys into that have been early.
positional.bull_case: Capex guides HELD-to-RAISED across all four hyperscalers while the stock trades at 29% of its 52w range and both canaries intact — this is the framework's textbook positional buy. Share capture positive, Rubin ramping to ~20% of DC, and the pullback is factor rotation not a franchise event.
positional.falsifier: Gross margin guide cut below 73% on Nov 17 (canary degraded) OR a second consecutive quarter of DSO rising while revenue decelerates (receivables canary confirmed) OR a hyperscaler capex GUIDE CUT (not an accounting trim) — any flips this to trim.

strategic.bear_case: This is a cyclical dressed as a compounder valued against its customers' CAPACITY TO FUND capex — and that capacity is now negative at two of four hyperscalers with a $740B+ 2026 ceiling that debt is increasingly funding. If coverage stays <1.0, the next leg is a capex guide cut and the whole multiple re-rates on peak earnings; the low forward PEG is a value trap on a cycle top.
strategic.bull_case: Forward PEG ~0.2-0.3, 71% FY28 growth management calls supply-CONSTRAINED, both canaries intact, share capture positive, $235B buyback capacity — if the hyperscalers' Q3/Q4 filings show OCF catching up to capex and coverage reclaims ≥1.2, this is a generational mispricing and the gate opens to a strategic strong buy.
strategic.falsifier: A full four-company TTM coverage read coming in ≥1.0 (ideally ≥1.2) with the capex guides held/raised and gross margin ≥70% — that opens the gate and flips strategic to the buy side; conversely a gross margin print <60% or forward PEG >2.5 would flip it to an outright trim.
